Definition: properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck)
BiblicalUsage: Kidod is a spark struck off, as from flint. Job 41:19 pictures Leviathan: out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spark shows what Leviathan is: a creature whose very breath is fire, and no man can stand before him.
